attempt_order_law: attempted_cells must be a duplicate-free subsequence of lawful_attempt_domain in exact canonical order; WVS7/C is never attempted
coverage_pointer_law: Every canonical row has cell_receipt and failure_receipt fields. QUALIFYING_CELL_COMPLETE requires cell_receipt and null failure_receipt. AUTHORIZED_STOP requires failure_receipt; if the cell appears in attempted_cells it also requires a stopped source-candidate cell_receipt. An unattempted cell may omit cell_receipt only when covered by an authorized common-source or court-interruption blocker. WVS7/C is unattempted and points to the preserved portability-failure receipt.
